debate.q1: We can talk about everything without fear of judgment.
debate.q2: When one speaks, the other truly listens without interrupting.
debate.q3: We manage to resolve our conflicts constructively.
debate.q4: We say 'I love you' regularly and sincerely.
debate.q5: We know how to express our needs without hurting each other.
debate.q6: Jealousy is not a problem in our couple.
debate.q7: We respect each other's personal space and friends.
debate.q8: We can be vulnerable in front of each other.
debate.q9: We don't hide anything important from each other.
debate.q10: We share the same vision of our common future.
debate.q11: We support each other's dreams and ambitions.
debate.q12: We're on the same page about children.
debate.q15: We have little rituals just for us.
debate.q17: We enjoy spending time together, even doing nothing.
debate.q18: Our physical attraction is still as strong.
debate.q19: We make efforts to surprise each other.
debate.r0d: You're incredibly connected! Your love is rare, deep, and authentic. You've found your soulmate.
debate.r0a: Keep cherishing this exceptional relationship. Never forget to nurture the unique complicity that is your strength.
debate.r1d: Your love is solid and fulfilled. You form a complicit couple that knows how to weather storms together.
debate.r1a: You're on the right track! Keep communicating and taking care of each other daily.
debate.r2d: You love each other sincerely. Some adjustments would further strengthen your bond.
debate.r2a: Invest time in your relationship. Plan moments alone and discuss your respective expectations.
debate.r3d: Your relationship has potential but requires effort. Communication is key.
debate.r3a: Take time to truly listen to each other. Express your needs with kindness and be open to compromises.
debate.r4d: Differences exist but nothing is lost. Love requires work.
debate.r4a: An honest dialogue is needed. Together, identify friction points and seek solutions. Couples counseling could help.
debate.r5d: Your relationship is going through a difficult period. It's time to take stock together.
debate.r5a: Step back and talk sincerely about your relationship. What do you really want? Professional support can help you see more clearly.
